'''White-spotted puffers''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found in [[tropical]] [[ocean]]s year-round, and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] white-spotted puffers for their ''ability to inflate''.
